steps.title: The two curves
steps.say: Demand slopes down: buyers want more at lower prices. Supply slopes up: sellers offer more at higher prices.

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: The curves cross at price 5 and quantity 5. This is the market before anything changes.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: More buyers want the good at every price, so the demand curve moves right.

steps.title: Why the price rises
steps.say: At the old price 5 there are now more buyers than goods, so the price is bid up until supply and demand meet again at a higher price.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Drag the demand curve back to where it started, then think about what a fall in demand would do to price.
